intro: A few parts of my life beyond research: running, aviation, sports, my dog Dewi, and time with the Duke and DKU communities.

sections.title: Running
sections.body: I enjoy running and am a former member of the DKU Varsity Running team. These are a few photos from my time running and training.

photos.caption: DKU Varsity Running.
photos.alt: Sean in his DKU Varsity Running jersey against a blue backdrop.

photos.caption: On the track at DKU.
photos.alt: Sean running on the DKU track with teammates beside the finish area.

sections.title: Orientation and campus life
sections.body: I served as an Orientation Leader across Duke and DKU programs in 2024, 2025, and 2026, helping incoming students settle into university life.

photos.caption: Orientation Leaders · 2024.
photos.alt: Four orientation leaders posing in front of a green 2024 DKU orientation backdrop.

photos.caption: Orientation Leaders · 2025.
photos.alt: Orientation leaders gathered around a table, smiling for a group selfie.

photos.caption: Orientation Leaders · 2026.
photos.alt: A group selfie with orientation leaders in a lecture room.

sections.title: Education and student leadership
sections.body: In 2024, I took part in the PEER–U-Corp school education initiative in Yuanling County, Hunan. In April 2026, I received DKU’s Student Leader of the Year award.

photos.caption: PEER–U-Corp · Yuanling County, Hunan · 2024.
photos.alt: Sean and middle-school students taking a group selfie in a school courtyard in Yuanling County.

photos.caption: Student Leader of the Year, with DKU’s Dean of Student Experience · April 2026.
photos.alt: Sean with DKU’s Dean of Student Experience for the Student Leader of the Year award.
